description: Art. 12 TUIR detrazioni per carichi di famiglia (anno d'imposta 2026)

spouse.notes: Sub-band supplements (EUR 10-30 in income range 29001-35200) not modelled; EUR 690 flat assumed in 15001-40000 range

children.notes: Figli under 21 not eligible (AUU from 2022-03-01, D.Lgs. 230/2021). Figli 21-29 and 30+ with disability are eligible.

other_dependents.notes: Post L. 207/2024: only ascendenti conviventi qualify. Other categories (fratelli, sorelle, generi, nuore, suoceri) no longer eligible.
